Q: How to implement SQLAlchemy 2.0 transactions in FastAPI routes while maintaining test isolation with Savepoints? A:

Update:

The issue was not related to the pytest fixtures.

One of my dependencies was executing session.get(), which implicitly started a transaction (I wasn’t aware of this). Since there was no commit or rollback, that transaction remained open. Later, the route code tried to start an explicit transaction with session.begin(), causing the “transaction already begun” error.

Q: Error while downloading google APIs Intel x86 atom system image A:

Clear the "Download Intermediates"

Android Studio stores partial downloads in a hidden folder. Deleting the contents of this folder forces the SDK Manager to start the download from scratch.

  • Close Android Studio completely.

  • Navigate to your SDK directory:

    • macOS: ~/Library/Android/sdk/.downloadIntermediates

    • Windows: C:\Users\<YourUsername>\AppData\Local\Android\Sdk\.downloadIntermediates

    • Linux: ~/Android/Sdk/.downloadIntermediates

  • Delete everything inside this folder (but keep the folder itself).

  • Also, check for a .temp folder in the same SDK root and clear its contents.

Q: Azure Service Bus WCF Relay functionality without using Hybrid Connections A:

I know this is probably not relevant for you anymore, but do you even need a dedicated listener for every service? Take a look at both the port bridge sample as well as the azbridge project. They do the same thing slightly differently; either one involves a small protocol to indicate which port to tunnel through. That way, only a single listener is needed that forwards the connections to different services (can also be on different machines), though that means you won't have a dedicated URL for each service without some additional setup.
